description: Find flights between two cities or airports and pick the dates. Handles vague requests directly — e.g. 'mid-December, 2-3 days, not on a weekend': pass earliest_depart/latest_return, nights_min/nights_max and avoid_weekdays and it returns the cheapest matching date pairs with fares. Also: exact dates, no date (cheapest dates), no destination (cheapest destinations, same filters apply). With dates (exact or a window) it checks live fares on Google Flights; otherwise, and as a fallback, it uses fares Aviasales travellers saw recently, each with the day seen and a link that reopens that fare at today's price.

avoid_weekdays.description: Days the trip must not touch, from departure to return day inclusive ('no weekend' → ['sat','sun']).

currency.description: 3-letter currency for fares, e.g. EUR, USD.

depart_date.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for flexible dates: returns the cheapest recently seen dates.

destination.description: Arrival city or airport (name or IATA code), e.g. 'Lisbon'. Omit for 'anywhere': returns the cheapest destinations.

earliest_depart.description: Flexible trip window start, YYYY-MM-DD ('mid-December' → 2026-12-10). Use with latest_return and/or nights instead of fixed dates: the tool picks the cheapest date pairs itself.

latest_return.description: Flexible trip window end, YYYY-MM-DD: be back by this day.

month.description: Flexible dates within this month, YYYY-MM (used when depart_date is omitted).

nights_max.description: Longest stay in nights for a flexible trip ('2-3 days' → 3).

nights_min.description: Shortest stay in nights for a flexible trip ('2-3 days' → 2).

origin.description: Departure city or airport (name or IATA code), e.g. 'Madrid' or 'MAD'.

return_date.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for one-way.

name: search_flights
title: Search flights
